response.sql: WITH per_scope AS (SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, order_count, CAST(order_count AS REAL) / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, CAST(order_count AS REAL) / AVG(order_count) OVER () AS multiple_of_scope_average FROM per_scope;

assumptions.assumption: Scopes with no matched orders are omitted because the requested counts are based on matched risk/margin records, orders, and users; the average is over scopes with at least one such order.
